home.heroSubtitle: Tiébissou, in the heart of Côte d'Ivoire
home.introTitle: A stop at the centre of everything
home.introBody: On the road linking the north of the country to the south, Le Relais du Centre is the address people remember. Some stop for a night, others come back for several days. Quiet rooms, a simple and generous table, a welcome that takes its time: here, the pause is not a constraint of travel — it is part of the journey.
home.roomsBody: Four categories, from essential comfort to a suite with its own terrace. All air-conditioned, all with a private bathroom.
home.servicesBody: A restaurant open for lunch and dinner, a bar for the end of the day, a garden to breathe in. The essentials, done well.
home.locationTitle: In Tiébissou, on the central route
home.locationBody: Right beside the main roads of central Côte d'Ivoire, easy to reach by car, with parking on site.
home.bookBody: Choose your dates, leave your details, pay the deposit by Mobile Money. Your confirmation arrives straight away.
home.welcomeP2: We keep four room categories, a table open at lunch and dinner, and a garden set back from the road. Nothing spectacular: attention, held to every day.
home.servicesLead: Three addresses within the house, open to hotel guests and passing visitors alike.

hotel.title: Our house
hotel.subtitle: Our story
hotel.lead: Le Relais du Centre grew from a simple idea: to offer, along the road, a place where you feel expected.
hotel.storyTitle: A stopping house that became an address
hotel.storyBody:
Tiébissou holds a particular place on the map: it is where the journeys between north and south, between Abidjan and the interior, cross paths. Such a crossroads needed a house able to welcome the traveller in a hurry as readily as the family driving home for the holidays, the work assignment as readily as the stay of a few days.

We wanted somewhere understated and warm, where every room is kept with care and where faces are remembered. The comfort of a hotel, the attention of a home.
hotel.value1Body: A front desk that is present, that answers, that knows the region and where to send you for dinner.
hotel.value2Body: Rooms kept peaceful, an inner courtyard and a garden set back from the noise of the road.
hotel.value3Body: The same cleanliness, the same service, on the first night as on the tenth. That is what brings people back.
hotel.quoteLead: What matters here fits in one line.
hotel.valuesLead: Three things we do not compromise on, because they are what brings people back.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: On site
services.lead: Everything you need to make the stop a pleasant one, without getting back in the car.
services.restaurantBody: Ivorian cooking and European dishes, served at lunch and dinner. A short menu, market produce, and a dish of the day that changes every morning. Open to hotel guests and passing visitors alike.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Good to know
faq.lead: Answers to the questions we are asked most often. If yours is not here, write to us or call the front desk.
faq.stillHereBody: The front desk answers every day, around the clock.

items.q: How do I book a room?
items.a: Online, in three steps: choose your dates and category, leave your details, pay the deposit. Confirmation is sent straight away. You can also call the front desk or message us on WhatsApp — we will record the booking for you.

items.q: Do I have to pay in full in advance?
items.a: No. A {percent}% deposit confirms the booking; the balance is settled on arrival.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Online: Mobile Money — Orange Money, Wave, MTN Money and Moov Money. On site: Mobile Money and cash.

items.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
items.a: Cancellation is free of charge up to {hours} hours before arrival. To change dates, call the front desk with your reference — it is quicker than cancelling and starting again.

items.q: I have not received my confirmation. What should I do?
items.a: Check your spam folder first. If you have paid and nothing arrives after a few minutes, call us with the reference shown on screen: we will find the booking immediately.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in from {checkIn}, check-out until {checkOut}. If you are arriving late at night, let us know: the front desk is open around the clock and we will be expecting you.
